title: Mind World Models: Joint Learning of Motor EEG Representations and Action-Conditioned World Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.27029v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Motor decoding from electroencephalography (EEG) supports non-invasive brain-computer interfaces, yet existing methods either rely on costly cue-based trials and coarse categorical labels or use pretraining objectives that do not directly capture how movement unfolds, limiting their ability to learn transferable motor representations. To this end, we propose the Mind World Model (MWM), a framework that learns motor EEG representations from scalable naturalistic EEG and egocentric video without action annotations. MWM treats EEG observed up to the current frame as the latent action of a world model: a mind model encodes the EEG, and a world model uses it to predict the representation of a future frame, yielding a movement-grounded pretraining objective. translated_title: 心灵世界模型：运动脑电表征与动作条件世界动力学的联合学习
translated_abstract: 来自脑电图（EEG）的运动解码为无创脑机接口提供了支持，然而现有方法要么依赖成本高昂的基于提示的试验范式和粗粒度的类别标签，要么采用无法直接刻画运动如何展开的预训练目标，限制了其学习可迁移运动表征的能力。为此，我们提出了心灵世界模型（Mind World Model, MWM），这是一个无需动作标注、能够从可扩展的自然情景脑电数据和第一人称视角视频中学习运动脑电表征的框架。MWM将截至当前帧所观测到的脑电视为世界模型的潜在动作：由一个心灵模型对脑电进行编码，再由一个世界模型利用该编码预测未来帧的表征，从而形成一个以运动为锚点的预训练目标。我们进一步引入了侧化感知Transformer（Lateralization-Aware Transformer, LAT），它利用帧平均来分离双侧共享特征与特定侧别的侧向特征，从而编码半球之间的对应关系……
tldr: 提出心灵世界模型（MWM），将脑电视为世界模型的潜在动作，从无动作标注的自然情景脑电与第一人称视频中学习运动脑电表征，并引入侧化感知Transformer（LAT）分离双侧共享与单侧特异特征，实现以运动为锚点的脑电预训练。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Mind World Model (MWM), which treats EEG as the latent action of a world model to learn motor EEG representations from naturalistic EEG and egocentric video without action annotations, and introduces a Lateralization-Aware Transformer (LAT) that separates shared bilateral from side-specific lateral features for movement-grounded pretraining.
